europe_now.title: EU Representation in Ukraine Peace Negotiations
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders have designated a group of member states, including France, Germany, the UK, Italy, and Poland alongside Brussels, to represent the bloc in upcoming peace negotiations concerning Ukraine rather than appointing a single envoy.

sources.headline: France among five major powers to represent EU in Ukraine talks
EU leaders hand Ukraine peace talks to France, Germany, UK, Italy, Poland plus Brussels – instead of a single envoy

europe_now.title: Commemoration of the Paris Terror Attacks
europe_now.summary: France has marked the eleventh anniversary of the November 13 Paris terrorist attacks with official tributes dedicated to remembering the victims.

sources.headline: November 13 Paris attacks: Eleven years later, France pays tribute to victims

top_stories.title: US Air Traffic Resumption
top_stories.summary: United States aviation authorities lifted a nationwide ground stop that had been implemented following an air traffic control communication issue. Normal air traffic operations have since resumed across the country.

sources.headline: United States resumes air traffic after nearly five-hour shutdown that forced 6,000 flight cancellations
US flights resume after nationwide ground stop lifted

top_stories.title: Microsoft Service Recovery
top_stories.summary: Microsoft announced that its consumer products have fully recovered following a global service disruption. Business services are also reported to be showing operational improvements.
